entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I need to return these ridiculous cycling shoes I bought. They're complete garbage and I want my money back. Now.

I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A preference? No! They're defective! I spent an hour setting up the cleats perfectly, and after one 20-mile ride, I have massive blisters on both heels. For what I paid, this is outrageous! I want a full refund, and I don't want to be interrogated.

I completely understand your frustration. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I apologize for the discomfort they've caused. Let me just pull up your order information to check the return eligibility.

You better check it fast. I'm a VIP member, I've spent thousands here. If I don't get this sorted out, I'm canceling my account and I'll make sure everyone in my cycling club knows VeloFit sells junk that injures people.

I appreciate you bringing this to my attention, and I thank you for your loyalty as a VIP member. Okay, I see your order for the cycling shoes was delivered 15 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days, so you are well within that timeframe. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
So you're actually going to help me? It's a full refund, back to my card?

Yes, absolutely. A full refund to your original payment method. I've just initiated the return process. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. And for the trouble this has caused, particularly with the blisters, I've also added a $25 store credit to your account for your next purchase as a thank you for your patience.
Okay. A refund and a credit. That's... acceptable. I'll watch for that email. This was a lot more hassle than it should have been.
I understand, and again, I do apologize. The shipping label is on its way, and the credit is active now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just get me my money back.
We will process it as soon as the item is received at our warehouse. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
